accepted.sentence: In Mexican banda ensembles, this instrument often joins other low-brass voices in harmonized riffs that drive dance arrangements.
Balkan brass ensembles may use its broad low-register tone to reinforce fast dance melodies and rhythmic accents.
Funk arrangements use its clipped, syncopated phrases to give horn-section passages a punchy rhythmic edge.
Contemporary composers exploit its continuously adjustable pitch for microtonal inflections between conventional semitone steps.
Some chamber composers pair it with live electronics, processing sustained tones into layered or spatial sound textures.
Pep bands use short repeated figures from it to rally spectators during breaks in sporting events.
In a brass-band test piece, its part may expose a player's control through sustained melodic lines and technical passages.
Composers sometimes place it beside a string quartet, using its sustained brass color to contrast with bowed textures.
